description_zh: 调用本接口更新应用信息
name: UpdateAppInfo

parameters.help_en: The application ID. This is the value of the AppId parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113266.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114000.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。为调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113266.html接口或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114000.html接口返回参数AppId的值
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The new application name.
The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).
UTF-8 encoding
parameters.help_zh:
期望修改的应用名称。
最多支持128个字符，仅支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和at字符（@）。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The new application description.
The description can be up to 512 characters in length.
UTF-8 encoding
parameters.help_zh:
期望修改的应用描述。
最多支持512个字符。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The new application status. Valid values:
Normal: Normal.
Disable: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
期望修改的应用状态。可选值：
Normal（正常启用）
Disable（停用）
parameters.name: status
